description: This Python module provides utility functions for configuring and generating tokens for LiveKit rooms. It handles creating JWT tokens for participants and agents, manages environment variable configurations, and supports command-line argument parsing to set up LiveKit sessions.

methods.name: str generate_token(room_name: str, participant_name: str, api_key: str, api_secret: str)
